(Japanese: ２ Episode 2) is the second regular chapter of the Pocket Monster: Liko's treasure manga. It was first published in the July 2023 issue of Ciao, released on June 2, 2023. It is based on the Pokémon Horizons: The Series episode The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two). It is 31 pages long.
